meta.title: Installation technician network by province
meta.description: Bluebolt's three dispatch regions on a map, a searchable list of all 34 provinces and service times by region.

title: The Bluebolt installation network, province by province
lead: See our three dispatch regions, all 34 provinces and the number of active technicians in each. Figures appear only after they have been checked against operating data.
mapTitle: Map of Vietnam, including the Hoang Sa (Paracel) and Truong Sa (Spratly) archipelagos

map.hint: Hover over or tap a province to see its region and technician count.
map.draftPinsNote: Draft dots at the centre of each province show where pins will sit once real technician counts are available. The published site does not show these dots.

stats.hiddenNote: Active technicians and provinces covered will appear here once operations supplies verified figures.

table.title: Find a province
table.intro: Type the name of a province or city, with or without Vietnamese accents, then filter by region if you need to.
table.searchHint: For example: da nang, Can Tho, hai phong
table.empty: No province matches. Try another name or choose All.

sla.title: Service times by region
sla.intro: Intake, scheduling and completion times for each region will appear here once Bluebolt publishes its official commitments.
sla.pending: Send us the provinces you need and our sales team will reply with specific times for each one.
sla.reviewIntro: Shown in the preview build only. This is what the old site and current policy say, not a commitment. Final values are set in content/sla.ts once approved.

cta.title: Roll out installations in your provinces
cta.body: Tell us your product category, expected volume and the provinces you need covered. Our sales team will get in touch to agree the scope and rollout schedule.

review.title: To be confirmed before publishing
review.regions: The three regions follow the old technician recruitment page (north from Ha Tinh, central from Quang Tri to Quang Ngai, south from Gia Lai). Operations still needs to confirm these are also the service-time regions.
review.counts: Technician counts per province stay empty until operations sends verified figures with an update date.
review.labels: The English labels for the two archipelagos await legal review; legal signs off the 360 px map screenshot before launch.
